content: Maya is the concept of illusion or the power that causes the world to appear as it is, concealing the true nature of Brahman. In Advaita Vedanta, maya is the cosmic illusion by which the one ultimate reality appears as the diverse phenomenal world. The Upanishads teach that maya is the veil that prevents the individual soul from recognizing its identity with Brahman.
